tasks.short: Review, classify and record survey data for computer analysis.

steps.what: Load actual existing survey responses into a source-linked preparation draft
inputs: actual survey instrument export: response ID, question/version ID, response value, missing status and capture time

steps.what: Review structured responses using native validity rules and fixed classification codebooks
inputs: actual approved validity rules and fixed classification codebook
outputs: rule-checked structured responses and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Classify actual open-text responses using source-linked code suggestions
inputs: rule-checked structured responses and unresolved exceptions
actual open-text answers and approved codebook
outputs: draft source-linked qualitative classifications with uncertainty

loop.purpose: Suggest fixed-codebook classifications for actual answers
loop.input: actual open-text responses and approved codebook
loop.check: Review source meaning, omissions, minority expressions and every proposed code; unresolved answers remain uncoded
loop.stop: Missing source/code definition or two failed checks returns to manual coding
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed matches handle exact responses first; variable language requires contextual suggestions

steps.what: Resolve exceptions and check final analysis-ready data, classifications and permitted destination
inputs: draft source-linked qualitative classifications with uncertainty
actual raw responses, codebook, validity rules and access requirements
outputs: checked final analysis-ready dataset with provenance and missingness

steps.what: Commit final classified survey dataset to the authorised analysis store
inputs: checked final analysis-ready dataset with provenance and missingness

tasks.design: Use native survey preparation and fixed validation/codebook rules in survey/qualitative-analysis software {OTHER}, with actual response exports staged in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Optional source-linked open-answer suggestions retain complete code review before separate dataset commitment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation can repeat response transfer, fixed validity checks and codebook assignment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rules and bounded fixed-codebook suggestions can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous answers and missingness need methodological judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher recognises a minority expression that does not fit the proposed code.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: survey exports, fixed validation and checked code suggestions can support preparation without inventing responses.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual respondents/interviewers produce captured answers through actual survey instrument; export provides response/question/version IDs, values, missingness and timestamps. Reject duplicate IDs, schema mismatch or absent provenance to manual reconciliation. No synthetic answers or free primary capture.

Native export/validation/codebook features first; existing runtime earns zero new saving. Structured/open-text alternatives reweight actual data. Researcher approves codebook and completely reviews proposed codes; new theme discovery not automated.
Dataset commit retained; any actual cross-system registry write or external delivery is separately final-version gated. Shared preparation with7547 counted once.
unknowns: Which response transfer and code assignment are actually manual?
research_questions: Do fixed rules and checked suggestions reduce total preparation after full exception review?

incremental.description: Maintain response schema/codebook mapping and audit coding errors.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final classified dataset, provenance and authorised analysis destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 transfer+25*0.60 validity+25*0.40 coding=40 gross minus1.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Complete methodological checks and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze surveys, old records or case studies using statistical software.

steps.what: Choose valid analysis methods, populations, weights and assumptions from actual research questions
inputs: actual checked dataset and sampling/missingness documentation

steps.what: Run and verify selected analyses through native saved statistical procedures
Analyze actual results, diagnostics, uncertainty and limitations without unsupported causal claims
Capture and check final analytical findings, procedure version and dataset lineage
outputs: checked final analysis record and storage destination

steps.what: Save final analysis record and reproducible procedure
inputs: checked final analysis record and storage destination
outputs: saved actual analytical findings and procedure

tasks.design: Configure native saved procedures in statistical-analysis software {OTHER}, using the checked data in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Retain method selection, diagnostics review, interpretation and full final analysis checking before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated specification entry and output assembly can recur for selected analyses.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved procedures can reproduce chosen computations.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling validity, assumptions and interpretation require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher rejects an apparently significant result that the design cannot support.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native saved statistical procedures can reduce repeated setup; analysis validity and interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Savings only actual repeated setup/output assembly, never computation runtime already provided by statistical software. Existing saved procedures earn zero new saving.

Actual dataset producer supplies checked data and lineage; preparation counted once with7548. Researcher sets weights/methods and fully checks outputs. Any actual findings delivery/publication is separately final-version gated, with no saving assumed.
research_questions: Do saved procedures reduce setup after complete diagnostics checking?

incremental.description: Maintain verified analysis procedures and versioned tests against known calculations.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final analysis record, procedure and storage destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 30*0.50=15 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. All actual scientific choices, interpretation and full checks retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose interviewer procedures, question protocols and examples from actual survey design
inputs: actual interviewer needs and approved handling procedures
outputs: chosen manual requirements and source content

steps.what: Assemble native manual sections around approved survey-specific procedures
inputs: chosen manual requirements and source content

steps.what: Draft interviewer explanations and examples from selected actual procedures
inputs: chosen manual requirements and source content

loop.input: actual survey instrument and selected approved procedures
loop.check: Check exact question meaning, neutral interviewing, omissions, permissions and invented instructions
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed checks returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed sections first; survey-specific explanations need contextual prose

steps.what: Check complete final manual against instrument version and actual interviewer use
inputs: actual instrument and approved interviewing procedures
outputs: checked final interviewer manual and exact permitted destinations

steps.what: Save final interviewer training manual
inputs: checked final interviewer manual and exact permitted destinations

steps.what: Release final manual to actual internal survey interviewers
inputs: checked final interviewer manual and exact permitted destinations

tasks.design: Configure native manual sections in {DOCS} and assist only source-bound interviewer explanations. Keep procedure choices and complete instrument/version checking before separate save and actual interviewer release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manuals can repeat fixed structures and explanation writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sections and checked drafting reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Instructions must preserve neutral interviewing and actual instrument meaning.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher identifies an example that would bias respondent answers.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sections and checked source-bound prose can support manual writing; survey-method decisions remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual instrument/procedure owners supply final source versions, researcher selects content and checks complete manual. Existing sections/drafting earn zero new saving.

Release only where owned; omit unused branch and reweight. External contract interviewers use actual external-send authority with same exact-final-content gate. Shared manual/training preparation with7558 counted once.
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total effort after full interviewer-protocol checks?

incremental.description: Maintain instrument-linked manual sections and audit drafting errors.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final manual, instrument version and storage destination; edits void check
s4 exact final manual and actual interviewer recipients/access; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.50+30*0.40=22 gross minus1.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Choices, full checks and actions retained.

tasks.short: Hire and train recruiters and data collectors.

steps.what: Assess actual recruiter/data-collector candidates and choose hiring decisions using relevant evidence
inputs: actual candidate applications, interviews and authorised checks

steps.what: Prepare and check final hiring offer, actual terms, authority and candidate
outputs: checked final authorised offer and exact candidate

steps.what: Send final authorised hiring offer to the actual candidate
inputs: checked final authorised offer and exact candidate

steps.what: Verify actual candidate acceptance and check final authorised appointment record
inputs: actual agreed terms and appointment authority

steps.what: Commit final authorised appointment record
Assemble recruiter/data-collector training from chosen approved survey procedures and native sections
inputs: actual approved survey procedures and reusable training sections

steps.what: Check complete final training materials against actual collection and recruitment requirements
Save final recruiter/data-collector training materials
Train actual recruiters and data collectors through practice, observation and feedback
outputs: actual training and observed competence findings

steps.what: Capture and check final actual training outcomes without inferring competence from attendance
inputs: actual training and observed competence findings
outputs: checked final actual training outcome record

steps.what: Save final actual training outcome record
inputs: checked final actual training outcome record

tasks.design: Keep actual hiring assessment, authorised offers and appointment records in {ATS}/{HCM} with separate final-version actions. Configure only reusable training sections in {LMS}/{DOCS}, retaining full checking, actual training and post-training outcome capture.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training can repeat approved method-section assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sections can reduce repeated preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Hiring fairness and practical competence require human assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher identifies a candidate or trainee who cannot yet collect valid data.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated training assembly; hiring decisions remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reusable training sections can reduce preparation; candidate assessment and competence decisions remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Researcher owns shown hiring actions only if actually authorised; otherwise actual authorised hiring owner performs offer/appointment and focal branch is removed/reweighted. No automated candidate ranking.

Candidate supplies actual acceptance; appointment not inferred from offer. Training outcomes occur only after actual practice. Native existing sections earn zero new saving; preparation shared with7559 counted once.

Separate hiring/training alternatives reweight actual work. Any actual learner-material delivery or appointment notice is separately final-version gated with no saving assumed. Existing checks serve gates without added self-approval time.
unknowns: Which hiring actions does the researcher actually own?
research_questions: Which training sections repeat beyond manual7559?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40=6 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual hiring, training, full checks and actions retained.
